Resolves #19687

An unmounted component no longer receives a settled `mountedPromise`, so `updateVdom()` cannot loop on one. That loop was the root of `LegacyPopupReturnNL:12`, the most frequent red in the Brain-gated burn-in. The diagnosis, from debugger stack samples and the paused frame on hosted runs, is on #19687.
- `component/Abstract.mjs` `mountedPromise`: a cached promise without a pending resolver is settled. While the component is unmounted, the getter drops it and creates a pending one.
- Why the fix lives in the getter: `container.Base#insert` copies an instance into another window with a raw `_mounted = false`. That write deliberately skips `afterSetMounted()`, and with it the unmount's reset of the promise. The dashboard's window drag takes this path. The cache's owner now holds the invariant for any path that clears `mounted` without the hook. The container's raw write stays as intended.

Evidence: L2 (unit arms, red first, with mutation checks; a hosted run of the unmodified e2e spec on this head) → L3 required for the ten-shard `dev` receipts. Residual: those receipts. Residual-Owner: #19657.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | `MountedPromise.spec.mjs` arm 1, through the real path: `target.add(widget, true, false)` from a container in another window. The widget reads `mounted: false`, and its promise stays pending and stays the same object for every waiter. The next mount settles it. |
| AC-2 | Arm 2: one `update()` on an unmounted component holding an earlier mount's promise. Before the fix it ran `update()` 20 times (the cap), after the fix once. |
| AC-3 | Pre-merge, [hosted](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/38315848558), on a temporary branch carrying only this head and its workflow: the unmodified `LegacyPopupReturnNL` passed 9 of 9. That covers three rounds alone, three back to back, and three of shard 4's 24 tests in their `dev` order. Before the fix it was red in every ten-shard `dev` run and on both attempts of the retry. The post-merge item below covers the ten-shard run. |

## Deltas from ticket
None.

## Test Evidence
- Both arms are red on `dev` before the fix: "Expected: 1, Received: 20" and "an earlier mount does not settle the next one". Both are green after it.
- Mutations, each reverted afterwards:
  - dropping `!me.mountedPromiseResolve` fails "every waiter gets the one pending promise";
  - dropping `!me.mounted` fails "and stays the same promise while mounted".
- `npm run test-unit`: 5042 passed, 2 skipped.

## Post-Merge Validation
- [x] `LegacyPopupReturnNL:12` passes in the next ten-shard `dev` run, on its first attempt. In [run 38319888826](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/38319888826), the first with this fix, shard 4 passed 24/24 with no retry. The run just before it, without the fix, needed the retry for this test.

### 🔬 Depth Floor

**Documented search:** I tested abandonment of existing pending waiters, repeated mounted reads, raw insertion without unmount-hook calls, and destroy cancellation. No delivered-scope concern remained. With the exact repaired getter, real `target.add(widget, true, false)` retains the source reference and inserts into the target, with zero unmount-hook calls; the new promise stays pending and identical until mount. An existing pending promise/resolver survives the same copy. One actual `update()` through `updateVdom` is one call; the unchanged getter produces the bounded 20-call loop. `trap(mountedPromise)` preserves the destroy sentinel.

**Rhetorical-Drift Audit:** The getter's resolver inference matches all production writers: its executor resolves immediately or stores a resolver; `afterSetMounted(true)` calls then deletes that resolver. Gallery/Calendar's manual hooks do not introduce another writer. This is a mount-state/cache guarantee, not proof of all browser capabilities.
